title: Show HN: Palmier Pro – Open-source macOS video editor built for AI
summary: Palmier Pro is an open-source macOS video editor developed by the Palmier team, featuring built-in AI generation capabilities and a local MCP server for connecting to AI agents. The editor enables features like AI-powered transitions, multicam editing with Codex integration, and automated conversion of long-form content into short clips.
problem_solved: Brings professional AI-powered video editing capabilities to macOS with native agent integration for automated workflows.
why_valuable: Combines open-source video editing with AI generation and agent connectivity, democratizing access to intelligent video production tools.
